architecture: Microsoft MXC ProcessContainer BaseContainer with FileProxyBridge

target.user_architecture_evidence: User-supplied processor screenshot; actual device execution remains untested.

compatibility_assessment.requested_scope: The user stated the project should be usable across Windows 11.
compatibility_assessment.reason: The existing backend requires an available BaseContainer/PSEC OS contract. The project rejects builds before 26100 and rejects AppContainer fallback; Microsoft documents newer servicing floors for Process Isolation.
compatibility_assessment.scope_limit: A minimum supported version is a compatibility restriction; being above it does not prove the exact product policy, networking or GUI operation works. A failed universality requirement must not be represented as proof that the current user device cannot work.

user_direction: Evaluate the existing architecture first; stop and discuss a replacement only after establishing that this architecture cannot meet the requirements.
core_outcomes: Selected applications use their assigned proxy node through the local panel.
YAML import remains available on Windows and Linux.
Visible applications start, remain usable, and stop with owned resources cleaned up.
existing_product_guarantees: Advertised network isolation and DNS protections must not be silently removed.
A passing capability probe alone does not establish usable networking or GUI compatibility.

fixed_sdk_contract_review.standard_sdk_model1: A nonempty egress allow list causes the SDK to add internetClient even when caller capabilities are empty; PSEC receives explicit endpoint WFP policy. Ingress deny does not add privateNetworkClientServer.
fixed_sdk_contract_review.product_G_difference: The fixed project G patch removes that automatic internetClient capability only under narrowly checked policy guards. Effective empty capabilities in G/G3 are not the standard SDK Model-1 capability selection.
fixed_sdk_contract_review.intra_container_loopback_contract: Fixed SDK documentation describes same-sandbox private loopback as usable and outside outbound IP/CIDR and host-to-container ingress policy. This is a documented expectation, not proof that the current target OS implements the tested policy successfully.
fixed_sdk_contract_review.upstream_report_scope: A third-party report on MXC 0.8.0 and Windows build 26200 describes internal-loopback blocking and a broad 127.0.0.1 allow workaround. It does not prove the fixed project's capability-null policy, exact UBR 9711, DNS protection or GUI operation.

lightweight_experience_review.payload_persistence: Memory-mapped rings flush at initialization; payload frames do not individually flush or fsync. Control/status JSON uses atomic replacement and fsync.
lightweight_experience_review.functional_transfer_evidence: Existing tests exercise multi-frame transfer and bidirectional half-close; these establish function, not user-perceived performance.
lightweight_experience_review.cleanup_limit: Sockets, workers and ring handles have bounded close paths. Bridge directory deletion is attempted with ignored rmtree errors; logical resource cleanup does not independently prove physical deletion.

desktop_application_contract_review.source_review: The product allows Win32k calls and own-window creation. SDK Job UI defaults still restrict cross-job window handles, global atoms, simulated input, desktop control and system settings.
desktop_application_contract_review.evidence_limit: GUI-enabled configuration does not prove Chromium/Electron or every traditional desktop application works; the target GUI fixture has not reached browser launch.

valid_evidence.scope: ordinary-user native x64 26200.9711; original G, no added enumeration control
ordinary-user native x64 26200.9711; unadopted G2 private-network-capability control
ordinary-user native x64 26200.9711; corrected profile, original G and pinned visible Chromium control
different Windows baseline; not target-version proof

invalid_or_nonconclusive_runs.reason: The evaluation payload omitted the host runtime-pins module. Experiments launched zero variants and contained application phases were blocked.
No completed guest phase results before VM timeout.

current_target_controls.preflight_review: Both corrected source-only controls completed the native target network experiments. Neither restored proxy transfer; the completed diagnostic phase is not product acceptance.

controls.policy: 127.0.0.1/32 TCP with equal start and end port

current_target_controls.shared_policy: empty caller capabilities; egress default deny; ingress default deny; host loopback deny; no SDK proxy or extra peer; automatic internetClient removed under fixed guards

decision_requirements: Use observed target-version results from a functioning harness; do not count installation, payload or unrelated test failures as framework failures.
If a control restores the required proxy path, validate visible application operation and teardown using that same executor and policy before declaring feasibility.
If the controls still fail, assess whether the SDK/API contract provides a supported path that preserves the agreed product behavior before declaring this architecture unable to meet it.
ARM or headless-browser failures alone do not establish failure of the user-requested visible native-x64 workflow.
Do not use elapsed development time, unit-test totals, or an unsupported policy as proof that the whole architecture is impossible.

assessment_summary.universal_windows_11_compatibility: Existing sole BaseContainer backend cannot cover every Windows 11 installation because of OS contract and servicing floors.
assessment_summary.current_user_target: Not deliverable. Corrected singleton and unrestricted-loopback TCP controls both ran on 26200.9711 and produced zero proxy transfers with parent/child TCP10013. Architecture impossibility is not established.
assessment_summary.lightweight_experience: Resource growth is bounded; user-invisible performance is not measured.
assessment_summary.implementation_action: Assessment only; no replacement backend adopted and no release published.

engineering_recommendation.decision: Stop extending BaseContainer as the sole Windows product backend and discuss a broadly compatible implementation with the user.
engineering_recommendation.basis: The user requested Windows 11-wide usability. A backend requiring newer OS contracts and servicing floors cannot cover every Windows 11 installation by itself.
engineering_recommendation.not_evidence_of_target_impossibility: Both controls now completed and failed to restore the proxy path. These failures do not prove every supported use of the architecture is impossible.
engineering_recommendation.already_running_diagnostics: Both G3 native controls completed; no further exploratory MXC policy runs are planned.
engineering_recommendation.next_scope: User authorized testing both free Sandboxie/WFP and InterceptSuite ProxyBridge/WinDivert with deployment simplicity as a hard gate. Neither is adopted.
